camps.traits: Baseline: clean 5-day by-day grid, 6 groups, 2 divisions, one lunch wave for everyone, 12h times, "Lunch Bunch" activity beside the Lunch event.
campB-style: three staggered lunch waves (Lunch 1/2/3) across consecutive blocks, 14 groups in 4 divisions, uneven 35/40-minute blocks, "Musik" typo, wrapped long names, every-other-day Library.
4-day week, 3 groups, 30-minute blocks with no gaps, 24h times, no lunch at all, "Swim Test" activity beside "Swim", blank cells.

6-day week, 24 groups + a lone CIT group in 7 divisions, 60-minute blocks, two lunch waves (CIT lunches with wave 2), 35 activities, split cells ("A - B"), single-day Saturday special and a weekly Thursday special.
Smallest camp: 2 groups, 7:30 start, 20-minute blocks, 24h times, one lunch wave, "Archary" typo.
Largest: 40 groups, 8 divisions, 50-minute blocks from 9:00 to a 4:55pm finish, three lunch waves, 40 activities including both colliding names, single-day Friday finale.
campA-style by-group pages with "Unit - Bunk" titles: 8 bunks in 3 units, two lunch waves, weekly Friday Swim Meet.
By-group, 4-day week, 12 bunks in 4 units, 30-minute blocks, 24h times, no lunch, narrow columns so long names wrap onto two lines, "Musik" typo, blank cells.
6-day by-group, 20 bunks in 5 units plus a lone "Counselor Aides" group, uneven 40/50-minute blocks, one lunch wave, split cells, single-day Thursday Campfire.
Sunday-to-Thursday week starting 7:30, 4 bunks in 2 units, 60-minute blocks, one lunch wave, "Lunch Bunch" activity.
campC-style day sheets (unlabeled time column, AM/PM, a room under each activity), 6 groups with positional codes 1A-2B, one lunch wave.
Day sheets, 4-day week, 10 groups, two lunch waves, 10:20 start to a 6:00pm finish, weekly Thursday Theme Day.
Day sheets, 16 groups, three lunch waves, split cells, "Musik" typo, every-other-day Library for all groups except 4D.
By-day pages headed "Period" with upper-case day titles, 24h times, 9 groups in 3 divisions, two lunch waves, and a weekly all-camp event whose name is also an activity ("Swim").
By-day "Period" pages, 6-day week, 18 groups in 6 divisions, uneven 30/35/45/55-minute blocks, no lunch, daily Snack event, blank cells, "Swim Test" activity.
